skills.name: Adjacency List Construction and Graph Validation
skills.when_to_use: When the graph structure is read from input but not fully validated, particularly when dealing with undirected graphs or edge directionality that affects connectivity representation
skills.instructions: Ensure that adjacency lists are constructed correctly by considering the directed/undirected nature of the input. For undirected graphs, each edge must be added in both directions. Validate that all nodes referenced in queries exist within the graph bounds (0 ≤ node < n) before proceeding to any algorithmic computation. Always use a consistent and safe initialization of data structures (e.g., vectors with proper size), and avoid assuming edge weights are always positive or non-zero unless explicitly confirmed by input format.
